connector.name: MCP Server by hostsmith
connector.registryDescription: Deploy static sites on Hostsmith - give it a file, get a live HTTPS URL. EU/US residency.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.hostsmith.net over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hostsmith account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: HOSTSMITH_API_DOMAIN
env.description: Override the upstream API domain across both partitions; 'us.api.' and 'eu.api.' are prepended to this value.

env.name: HOSTSMITH_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL with a single fixed value, bypassing partition selection entirely.
